author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
I wanted a simple way to keep my drills right where I need them, so I turned a few pieces of ABS pipe into custom drill holsters for the workbench. Cheap, easy, and one of those little upgrades that makes the whole shop work better.

Want to see how I built the entire workbench, including the storage, drawers and built-in table saw? Watch the full workbench build on the channel.

If you found this video useful and entertaining please subscribe to our channel 💪
